description: Core Drupal bootstrap functions loaded on every request, including error handling, static variable management, and test utilities.

methods.name: t
methods.description: Translates a string to the current language or a specified language, returning a TranslatableMarkup object.

methods.name: _drupal_error_handler
methods.description: Custom PHP error handler that includes errors.inc and delegates to _drupal_error_handler_real.

methods.name: _drupal_exception_handler
methods.description: Custom PHP exception handler that logs errors and handles Throwable exceptions.

methods.name: _drupal_exception_handler_additional
methods.description: Displays additional errors caught during exception handling.

methods.name: drupal_valid_test_ua
methods.description: Validates or retrieves the test prefix for internal test requests based on user agent and HMAC.

methods.name: drupal_generate_test_ua
methods.description: Generates a user agent string with HMAC and timestamp for testing purposes.

methods.name: drupal_maintenance_theme
methods.description: Loads and initializes the theme system for maintenance mode or database failure.

methods.name: drupal_static
methods.description: Provides static variable storage with optional reset capability.

methods.name: drupal_static_reset
methods.description: Resets static variables, with specific handling for 'node_access_view_all_nodes'.

methods.name: drupal_register_shutdown_function
methods.description: Registers a shutdown function with exception handling.

methods.name: _drupal_shutdown_function
methods.description: Executes registered shutdown functions, handling exceptions.

methods.name: _drupal_shutdown_function_handle_exception
methods.description: Logs and displays errors during shutdown, if PHP-FPM is not used.
